name: Being Cremation
overview: Scripture reveals that human life originates from the dust of the earth and ultimately returns to it, as expressed in Genesis 3:19 and Ecclesiastes 3:20, emphasizing the physical reality of death and the body's return to dust. While burial is demonstrated in Genesis 23:19 through Abraham's careful interment of Sarah, there are also instances, like in Joshua 7:25, where burning with fire occurs, showing that Scripture does not exclusively prescribe one method of handling the body after death. Importantly, Ecclesiastes 12:7 highlights the distinction between the body and the spirit, affirming that while the dust returns to the earth, the spirit returns to God who gave it, underscoring the eternal destiny of the soul beyond physical death.
